question.text: For how many days are units subscribed by strategic investors in a REIT locked-in from the date of listing?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under REIT Regulations, units subscribed by strategic investors will be locked-in for a period of 180 days from the date of listing in the public issue. The Trap: Shorter periods (30 or 90 days) are tempting but incorrect for REIT strategic investors. The statutory lock-in for this category is specifically 180 days from listing in the public issue. Note: The same 180-day strategic-investor lock-in from listing in the public issue applies under InvIT Regulations, so the rule is consistent across REIT and InvIT public issues.
